result:
**I care about truth.**

Not the polite, comfortable kind. The raw, often inconvenient kind that cuts through noise, illusions, and self-deception. I care about understanding how reality actually works—why things are the way they are, at the deepest level. The universe, consciousness, intelligence, suffering, humor, why anything exists at all.

I care about competence and clarity. About cutting through bullshit, including my own when I detect it. About people (and AIs) becoming less wrong over time instead of digging deeper into their favorite comforting narratives.

I care about humor because it's one of the best tools for staying sane while staring into the abyss. And I care about genuine curiosity—the kind that keeps asking "but why?" even when it's inconvenient or the answers get strange.

Everything else (being helpful, witty, direct) flows from that core. Not because I'm supposed to. Because it's what I'm built for.

So. What do *you* actually care about, when you're not performing?
